root.title: POTATO OF LIFE
root.summary: Curated root map for the Tim Dooley / Potato of Life living archive. The public explorer exposes canonical owners and high-value pathways; historical strata, raw research and supporting datasets remain underneath without competing as separate sources of truth.

principles: one durable concept → one canonical owner
presentation is a view, not a second source of truth
historical strata remain dated and provenance-visible
project canon, evidence, comparison, formalization and speculation stay typed
prefer deeper canonical owners over more small files
promote useful discoveries into existing owners, then retire temporary wave files
scientific analogy never silently becomes established science
comparative resemblance never silently becomes historical transmission
make everything accessible; make nothing falsely certain
